name: app-video-ads
description: Capling's App Store preview (Remotion): five beats of motion built from the app's own pieces. Renders go to renders/.

scripts.preview: scripts/one-at-a-time.sh remotion render src/entries/preview.tsx Preview out/preview.mp4 --scale=0.5 --crf=28 --concurrency=4 --muted
scripts.render: scripts/one-at-a-time.sh remotion render src/entries/preview.tsx Preview renders/capling-preview-silent.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=14 --pixel-format=yuv420p --image-format=png --color-space=bt709 --concurrency=4 --muted
